### 1 . Error detection data analysis


```{r error-detection-data-cleaning-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


# questionnaire data cleaning
clean_questionnaire_robust <- function(file_path) {
  
  df_raw <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df_subset <- df_raw %>%
    select(participant_id, 
           question_id = stimuli_presented, 
           answer = response_value)
  
  df_wide <- df_subset %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = question_id,
      values_from = answer
    )
  
  df_final <- df_wide %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
  
  return(df_final)
}

# batch processing for annotated error detection data
process_batch_error_detection <- function(batch_pattern, batch_label, folder_name) {
  
  message(paste("Processing:", batch_label, "..."))
  
 # find annotated files
  annotated_files <- list.files(
    path = "../data/annotated/", 
    pattern = paste0(batch_pattern, ".*(FB|JB|HH)\\.csv"), 
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  if(length(annotated_files) == 0) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No annotated files found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # find questionnaire data
  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)
  quest_file <- list.files(path = target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  
  if(is.na(quest_file)) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No questionnaire found."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  
  df_exp <- map_dfr(annotated_files, read_csv, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    distinct()
  
  # filter participants who did not engage with the experiment
  # this means that there will be no coder names
  df_exp <- df_exp %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% filter(any(!is.na(coder))) %>% ungroup()
  
  # attention checks
  df_exp <- df_exp %>%
    mutate(
      comments = as.character(comments),
      attention_score_8 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/8)")),
      attention_score_7 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/7)"))
    )
  
  failed_ids <- unique(c(
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_8 < 6) %>% pull(participant_id),
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_7 == 4) %>% pull(participant_id)
  ))
  
  df_exp <- df_exp %>% mutate(attention_check_passed = !participant_id %in% failed_ids)
  

  df_quest_clean <- clean_questionnaire_robust(quest_file)
  
  # join data
  df_final <- df_exp %>%
    left_join(df_quest_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
    mutate(batch_id = batch_label) 
  
  return(df_final)
}


#### define the batches ####

  ~batch_pattern, ~batch_label,           ~folder_name,
  "batch3",       "Batch 3",   "main_batch3"
)

df_analysis_targets <- df_clean_all_trials %>%
  filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
  mutate(
    err_reported_clean = case_when(
      err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
      TRUE ~ err_reported
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")),
    err_reported_label = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
      err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",

      err_reported_attempt == "first" ~ "First Attempt",
      err_reported_attempt == "secsame" ~ "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)",
      err_reported_attempt == "secdiff" ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)",
      TRUE ~ err_reported_attempt
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean %in% c("y", "nans", "nun"))

# An a priori power analysis based on data from the test run where the randomization worked correctly (N=3). For the primary hypothesis (Phonological Interference: Does the presence of a second error (Non-Phonological) make it harder for the participant to spot the Phonological error?), it suggested that a sample size of N=26 would be sufficient to achieve 80% power at alpha=.05. If we account for participant exclusion rates and we want to improve sensitivity for secondary and other hypotheses, we could set a target sample size of N=40
```

#### 1.1 Analysis and plots

```{r error-detection-functions-to-create-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

run_plotting_pipeline <- function(df_input) {
  

  condition_colors <- c(
    "phon_err"     = "lightsalmon",
    "non_phon_err" = "skyblue",
    "both_err"     = "plum3", 
    "correct"      = "palegreen3"
  )
  
  feature_colors <- c(
    "phon"    = "lightsalmon",
    "nonphon" = "skyblue"
  )
  
  fa_color <- "wheat3"
  

  
  error_type_labels <- c(
    "p"          = "Phonological (Intended)",
    "p?"         = "Phonological (Uncertain)",
    "np"         = "Non-Phon (Intended)",
    "np?"        = "Non-Phon (Uncertain)",
    "both"       = "Both Intended Errors",
    "acheckp"    = "Attn Check (Pass)",
    "acheckf"    = "Attn Check (Fail)",
    "otherp"     = "Other Phon (Irrelevant)",
    "othernp"    = "Other Non-Phon (Irrelevant)",
    "otherfill"  = "Reported Filler Error",
    "otherirr"   = "Other Irrelevant (Style/Conciseness)",
    "otherwrong" = "Wrong Selection/Typo",
    "other"      = "Other (Misc)"
  )
  
  df_input <- df_input %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    mutate(trial_num_sequential = match(question, unique(question))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  df_analysis <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = case_when(
        err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
        TRUE ~ err_reported
      ),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")),
      err_reported_label = case_when(
        err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
        err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
        err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
      ),
      attempt_label = case_when(
        agrepl("first", err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 1) ~ "First Attempt",
        agrepl("secsame", err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 2) ~ "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)",
        agrepl("secdiff", err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 2) ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)",
        TRUE ~ err_reported_attempt
      ),
      accuracy_label = case_when(
        no_err_response == "a" ~ "Accurate",
        no_err_response == "w" ~ "Wrong",
        no_err_response == "blank" ~ "Blank",
        no_err_response == "corrected" ~ "Corrected",
        no_err_response == "twice" ~ "Same Response Twice",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      quest_exposure_spanish_accent = factor(
        as.numeric(quest_exposure_spanish_accent), 
        levels = 1:5, 
        labels = c("Never", "Sometimes", "Half the time", "Often", "All the time"), 
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean %in% c("y", "nans", "nun"))
  
  df_trial_level <- df_analysis %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      is_reported = any(err_reported_clean == "y"),
      detected_phon = any(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both")),
      detected_nonphon = any(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both")),
      final_label = case_when(
        any(err_reported_clean == "y") ~ "Question needs correction",
        any(err_reported_clean == "nun") ~ "Unsure",
        TRUE ~ "Question has no errors"
      ),
      quest_exposure_spanish_accent = first(quest_exposure_spanish_accent),
      trial_num = first(trial_num_sequential), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  

  
  # (A) Was there error reported?
  # They ARE reporting errors
  plot_data_A_part <- df_trial_level %>%
    count(participant_id, condition, final_label) %>%
    complete(participant_id, condition, final_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, condition) %>%
    mutate(Total = sum(n), Prop = n / Total) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  plot_summary_err_reported <- plot_data_A_part %>%
    group_by(condition, final_label) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Proportion = mean(Prop, na.rm=TRUE), 
      SE = sd(Prop, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE, ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE) %>%
    rename(err_reported_label = final_label)
  
  pA <- ggplot(plot_summary_err_reported, 
               aes(x = condition, y = Mean_Proportion, fill = err_reported_label, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.25, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Proportion of Responses", fill = "Participant Response", 
         title = "Did participants report an error?") 
  
  
  # (B) Hit Rate
  # Higher detection rate for non-phon errors 
  plot_data_B <- df_trial_level %>%
    filter(condition != "correct") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(
      phon_mean = mean(detected_phon),
      phon_se   = sd(detected_phon) / sqrt(n()),
      nonphon_mean = mean(detected_nonphon),
      nonphon_se   = sd(detected_nonphon) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -condition, 
                 names_to = c("Type", ".value"), 
                 names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)") %>% 
    filter(
      (condition == "phon_err" & Type == "phon") |
      (condition == "non_phon_err" & Type == "nonphon") |
      (condition == "both_err")
    )
  
  pB <- ggplot(plot_data_B, aes(x=condition, y=mean, fill=Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(0.9), color="black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), 
                  position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = feature_colors) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels=percent, limits=c(0,1)) +
    labs(title="Hit rate: Did participants report the intended error(s)?", 
         y = "Detection Rate") 
  
  
  # (C) When was the error reported? (By Error Type)
  # we collapse "First Attempt" and "Second Attempt (skipped/same)" into a single category
  # to contrast against instances where the answer was actually changed.

 plot_data_C <- df_analysis %>% 
   filter(err_reported_clean == "y", !is.na(attempt_label)) %>%
   mutate(
     reported_category = case_when(
       err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?")    ~ "Phonological",
       err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?") ~ "Non-Phonological",
       err_type_response == "both"            ~ "Both Errors",
       TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
     ),
     attempt_group = case_when(
       attempt_label %in% c("First Attempt", "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)") ~ "First Attempt / Unchanged",
       attempt_label == "Second Attempt (Changed)" ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)", 
       TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
     )
   ) %>%
   filter(!is.na(reported_category), !is.na(attempt_group))
  
pC <- ggplot(plot_data_C, aes(x = reported_category, fill = attempt_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(title = "When are different error types reported?", 
       subtitle = "Comparing 'Changed' vs 'Unchanged' responses across error types",
       x = "Reported Error Type",
       y = "Proportion", 
       fill = "Response Status")
  
  
# (D) Accuracy No Error
# we calculate the specific proportion of "a" (Accurate) responses 
# relative to the total valid questions in each condition.

 plot_data_D <- df_analysis %>% 
   filter(err_reported_clean == "nans",   
          !is.na(accuracy_label),                
          accuracy_label != "Other") %>%  
   group_by(condition) %>%
   summarise(
     accuracy_prop = mean(accuracy_label == "Accurate") 
   )

pD <- ggplot(plot_data_D, aes(x = condition, y = accuracy_prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey", color = "black") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Accuracy of Trivia Answer when NO error was reported", 
       subtitle = "Proportion of accurate ('a') responses by condition",
       x = "Condition",
       y = "Accuracy Proportion")
  

 # (E) Detailed Error Breakdown (Split into E1 and E2)


 data_E <- df_analysis %>% 
   filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
   filter(!is.na(err_type_response) & err_type_response != "NA") %>%
   filter(
     !(condition == "phon_err" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both")),
     !(condition == "non_phon_err" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"))
   )

 condition_totals <- data_E %>%
   filter(condition != "correct") %>%
   count(condition, name = "total_n_condition")

 plot_data_E_summary <- data_E %>% 
   filter(condition != "correct") %>% 
   count(condition, err_type_response) %>% 
   left_join(condition_totals, by = "condition") %>%
   mutate(P = n / total_n_condition) 

 # Intended/Uncertain Errors Only

 pE1 <- ggplot(plot_data_E_summary %>% 
                 filter(err_type_response %in% c("p","p?","np","np?","both")), 
               aes(x=err_type_response, y=P, fill=condition)) +
   geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
   facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
   scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) + 
   scale_y_continuous(labels=percent, limits = c(0,1)) + 
   scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(error_type_labels[x], width=10)) +
   labs(title="Detailed Error Breakdown | Intended Errors Only", 
        x="Error type", y="Proportion") + 
   theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

 # All annotated responses
 pE2 <- ggplot(plot_data_E_summary, 
               aes(x=err_type_response, y=P, fill=condition)) +
   geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
   facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
   scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) + 
   scale_y_continuous(labels=percent, limits = c(0,1)) +
   labs(title="Error Breakdown | All Annotated Responses", 
        x="Error type", y="Proportion") + 
   theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1, vjust=0.5))


  
  # (F) Detection Over Time
  
  plot_data_F_cumulative <- df_trial_level %>% 
    filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")) %>%
    # create the relative sequence (Exposure Order)
    # group by participant and arrange by time to see their specific order
    arrange(participant_id, trial_num) %>% 
    group_by(participant_id) %>% 
    mutate(exposure_seq = row_number()) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    
    # group by this new sequence number to get the average at each step
    group_by(exposure_seq, condition) %>% 
    summarise(
      detection_rate = mean(detected_phon, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(detected_phon, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  pF1 <- ggplot(plot_data_F_cumulative, 
               aes(x = exposure_seq, y = detection_rate, color = condition)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = detection_rate - se, ymax = detection_rate + se), 
                  width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
    labs(title = "Trial-by-Trial Phonological Error Detection Performance (Targets Only)", 
         subtitle = "Comparison of Single vs. Double Error detection across the experiment",
         y = "Proportion of Intended Errors Detected",
         x = "Cumulative Target Presentation Order (1st target seen ... 12th target seen)")
  
  
  plot_data_F_separate <- df_trial_level %>% 
    filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")) %>%
    
    # sort by time so we know which came first
    arrange(participant_id, trial_num) %>% 
    
    # group by participant & condition
    group_by(participant_id, condition) %>% 
    
    # 'row_number' counts 1..6 for Phon, and 1..6 for Both
    mutate(exposure_seq = row_number()) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    
    group_by(exposure_seq, condition) %>% 
    summarise(
      detection_rate = mean(detected_phon, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(detected_phon, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  pF2 <- ggplot(plot_data_F_separate, 
               aes(x = exposure_seq, y = detection_rate, color = condition)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = detection_rate - se, ymax = detection_rate + se), 
                  width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
    labs(title = "Phonological Error Detection Rate by Condition Exposure", 
         subtitle = "Average performance on the 1st through 6th trial of each type",
         y = "Proportion of Intended Errors Detected",
         x = "Number of Previous Encounters with this Error Type")
  
  
  
  print(pA); print(pB); print(pC); print(pD); 
  print(pE1); print(pE2); print(pF1); print(pF2)
  
  message("--- Successfully generated all plots! ---")
}
```

#### Trial-level GLMER with Signal Detection Framework

##### Standard GLMER

```{r setting-df-ready-for-glmer, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


##### Both attempts #####
df_clean <- df_clean_all_trials %>%
  filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
  mutate(
    err_reported_clean = case_when(
      err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
      TRUE ~ err_reported
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
  )

# collapse multiple attempts into one result per trial
# if they reported the error in Attempt 1 or Attempt 2, it counts as a hit (1).
df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    reported_phon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0)),
    reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# phonological view
df_phon_view <- df_trial_coded %>%
  mutate(ErrorType = "Phon", 
         Reported = reported_phon, 
         Present = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0),
         OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0))

# non-phonological view
df_nonphon_view <- df_trial_coded %>%
  mutate(ErrorType = "NonPhon", 
         Reported = reported_nonphon, 
         Present = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0),
         OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0))


df_long <- bind_rows(df_phon_view, df_nonphon_view) %>%
  select(participant_id, question, ErrorType, Reported, Present, OtherTypePresent)

# center variables
df_long$Present_c <- df_long$Present - 0.5
df_long$OtherTypePresent_c <- df_long$OtherTypePresent - 0.5

# Sum coding for ErrorType
df_long$ErrorType <- as.factor(df_long$ErrorType)
contrasts(df_long$ErrorType) <- contr.sum(2) 
# NonPhon is 1 or -1



##### First attempt only #####

df_clean_first_att <- df_clean_all_trials %>%
  filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, question) %>%
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    err_reported_clean = case_when(
      err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
      TRUE ~ err_reported
    ),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
  )


df_trial_coded_first_att <- df_clean_first_att %>%
  group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    reported_phon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0)),
    reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


df_phon_view_first_att <- df_trial_coded_first_att %>%
  mutate(ErrorType = "Phon", 
         Reported = reported_phon, 
         Present = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0),
         OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0))

df_nonphon_view_first_att <- df_trial_coded_first_att %>%
  mutate(ErrorType = "NonPhon", 
         Reported = reported_nonphon, 
         Present = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0),
         OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0))

df_long_first_att <- bind_rows(df_phon_view_first_att, df_nonphon_view_first_att) %>%
  select(participant_id, question, ErrorType, Reported, Present, OtherTypePresent)


df_long_first_att$Present_c <- df_long_first_att$Present - 0.5
df_long_first_att$OtherTypePresent_c <- df_long_first_att$OtherTypePresent - 0.5


df_long_first_att$ErrorType <- as.factor(df_long_first_att$ErrorType)
contrasts(df_long_first_att$ErrorType) <- contr.sum(2) 
# NonPhon=1, Phon=-1
```

##### Standard GLMER Plots

###### Two Attempts
```{r err-detection-glmer-with-signal-detection-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
prepare_aligned_sdt_data <- function(df_input) {
  
  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = case_when(
        err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
        TRUE ~ err_reported
      )
    )
  
  df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      reported_phon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0)),
      reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df_phon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Phonological",
      Reported = reported_phon,
      IsSignal = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, IsSignal, Reported)
  
  df_nonphon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Non-Phonological",
      Reported = reported_nonphon,
      IsSignal = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, IsSignal, Reported)
  
  df_long <- bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon)
  
  return(df_long)
}


calculate_sdt_metrics <- function(df_long) {
  
  sdt_stats <- df_long %>%
    group_by(participant_id, ErrorType) %>%
    summarise(
      hits = sum(Reported == 1 & IsSignal == 1),
      misses = sum(Reported == 0 & IsSignal == 1),
      fas = sum(Reported == 1 & IsSignal == 0),
      crs = sum(Reported == 0 & IsSignal == 0),
      hit_rate = (hits + 0.5) / (hits + misses + 1),
      fa_rate = (fas + 0.5) / (fas + crs + 1),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # d' and c
      z_hr = qnorm(hit_rate),
      z_fa = qnorm(fa_rate),
      d_prime = z_hr - z_fa,
      c_bias = -(z_hr + z_fa) / 2
    )
  
  return(sdt_stats)
}

  
run_glmer_plots <- function(sdt_data) {
  
  my_colors <- c("lightsalmon", "skyblue") 
  
  stat_sens <- tibble(
    group1 = "Phonological", 
    group2 = "Non-Phonological",
    p.adj = "0.017", 
    p.signif = "*",
    y.position = max(sdt_data$d_prime) + 0.2
  )
  
  stat_bias <- tibble(
    group1 = "Phonological", 
    group2 = "Non-Phonological",
    p.adj = "0.64", 
    p.signif = "ns",
    y.position = max(sdt_data$c_bias) + 0.2
  )

  # sensitivity 
  p_dprime <- ggboxplot(
    sdt_data, x = "ErrorType", y = "d_prime", fill = "ErrorType", 
    palette = my_colors, add = "jitter",
    add.params = list(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgray")
  ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_sens, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 10) +
    labs(
      title = "Sensitivity (d') by Error Type - Two Attempts",
      subtitle = "Standard GLMER Result: p = .017",
      y = "Sensitivity (d')", x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))
  
  # bias
  p_bias <- ggboxplot(
    sdt_data, x = "ErrorType", y = "c_bias", fill = "ErrorType", 
    palette = my_colors, add = "jitter",
    add.params = list(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgray")
  ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_bias, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0, label = "Neutral Bias", vjust = -1, fontface="italic", size=3) +
    labs(
      title = "Response Bias (c) by Error Type - Two Attempts",
      subtitle = "Standard GLMER Result: p = .64 (ns)",
      y = "Bias (c)", x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))
  
  print(p_dprime)
  print(p_bias)
}

df_aligned <- prepare_aligned_sdt_data(df_clean_all_trials)

sdt_metrics_new <- calculate_sdt_metrics(df_aligned)

run_glmer_plots(sdt_metrics_new)
```


```{r err-detection-glmer-with-signal-detection-plots-interaction effects, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

prepare_interaction_data <- function(df_input) {
  
  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(err_reported_clean = case_when(err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans", TRUE ~ err_reported))
  
  df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      reported_phon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0)),
      reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df_phon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")) %>% 
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Phonological", 
      Reported = reported_phon, 
      Context = if_else(condition == "both_err", "Dual (Both)", "Single (Alone)")
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, Context, Reported)
  
  df_nonphon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err")) %>% 
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Non-Phonological", 
      Reported = reported_nonphon, 
      Context = if_else(condition == "both_err", "Dual (Both)", "Single (Alone)")
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, Context, Reported)
  
  df_long <- bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon)
  
  df_long$Context <- factor(df_long$Context, levels = c("Single (Alone)", "Dual (Both)"))
  
  return(df_long)
}


calculate_hit_rates <- function(df_long) {
  df_long %>%
    group_by(participant_id, ErrorType, Context) %>%
    summarise(
      hit_rate = mean(Reported), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


run_masking_plot <- function(plot_data) {
  
  my_colors <- c("lightsalmon", "skyblue") 
  
  ggline(
    plot_data, x = "Context", y = "hit_rate", color = "ErrorType",
    add = c("mean_se", "jitter"),
    palette = my_colors,
    position = position_dodge(0.2), 
    size = 1 
  ) +
    labs(
      title = "The Masking Effect (Both Attempts)",
      subtitle = "Does detection drop when a second error is added?\n(Downward slope = Masking)",
      y = "Hit Rate (Probability of Detection)",
      x = NULL,
      caption = "GLMER Result: Marginal Masking Trend (p = .064)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size=12)
    )
}
```

```{r sdt-glmer-plots-first-attempt-only, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
prepare_sdt_data_attempt1 <- function(df_input) {
  
  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question) %>%
    slice(1) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = case_when(
        err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
        TRUE ~ err_reported
      )
    )
  
  df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(
      reported_phon = if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0),
      reported_nonphon = if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)
    )

  df_phon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Phonological",
      Reported = reported_phon,
      IsSignal = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, IsSignal, Reported)
  
  df_nonphon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Non-Phonological",
      Reported = reported_nonphon,
      IsSignal = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, IsSignal, Reported)
  
  return(bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon))
}

run_plots_attempt1 <- function(sdt_data) {
  
  my_colors <- c("lightsalmon", "skyblue") 
  
  stat_sens <- tibble(
    group1 = "Phonological", 
    group2 = "Non-Phonological",
    p.adj = "0.23", 
    p.signif = "ns",
    y.position = max(sdt_data$d_prime) + 0.2
  )
  
  stat_bias <- tibble(
    group1 = "Phonological", 
    group2 = "Non-Phonological",
    p.adj = "0.80", 
    p.signif = "ns",
    y.position = max(sdt_data$c_bias) + 0.2
  )

 
  p_dprime <- ggboxplot(
    sdt_data, x = "ErrorType", y = "d_prime", fill = "ErrorType", 
    palette = my_colors, add = "jitter",
    add.params = list(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgray")
  ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_sens, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5) +
    labs(
      title = "Sensitivity (d') - 1st Attempt",
      subtitle = "Standard GLMER Result: No Difference (p = .23)",
      y = "Sensitivity (d')", x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))
  

  p_bias <- ggboxplot(
    sdt_data, x = "ErrorType", y = "c_bias", fill = "ErrorType", 
    palette = my_colors, add = "jitter",
    add.params = list(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgray")
  ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_bias, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0, label = "Neutral Bias", vjust = -1, fontface="italic", size=3) +
    labs(
      title = "Response Bias (c) - 1st Attempt",
      subtitle = "Standard GLMER Result: No Difference (p = .80)",
      y = "Bias (c)", x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))
  
  print(p_dprime)
  print(p_bias)
}

run_plots_attempt1(sdt_metrics_att1)
```

```{r sdt-glmer-plots-first-attempt-only-interaction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
prepare_interaction_data_att1 <- function(df_input) {
  
  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question) %>%
    slice(1) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(err_reported_clean = case_when(err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans", TRUE ~ err_reported))
  
  df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(
      reported_phon = if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both"), 1, 0),
      reported_nonphon = if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both"), 1, 0)
    )

  df_phon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")) %>% 
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Phonological", Reported = reported_phon, 
      Context = if_else(condition == "both_err", "Dual (Both)", "Single (Alone)")
    ) %>% select(participant_id, ErrorType, Context, Reported)
  
  df_nonphon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err")) %>% 
    mutate(
      ErrorType = "Non-Phonological", Reported = reported_nonphon, 
      Context = if_else(condition == "both_err", "Dual (Both)", "Single (Alone)")
    ) %>% select(participant_id, ErrorType, Context, Reported)
  
  df_long <- bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon)
  df_long$Context <- factor(df_long$Context, levels = c("Single (Alone)", "Dual (Both)"))
  
  return(df_long)
}


run_masking_plot_att1 <- function(plot_data) {
  
  my_colors <- c("lightsalmon", "skyblue") 
  
  ggline(
    plot_data, x = "Context", y = "hit_rate", color = "ErrorType",
    add = c("mean_se", "jitter"),
    palette = my_colors,
    position = position_dodge(0.2), size = 1 
  ) +
    labs(
      title = "The Masking Effect (1st Attempt Only)",
      subtitle = "Does detection drop when a second error is added?\n(Downward slope = Masking)",
      y = "Hit Rate (Probability of Detection)",
      x = NULL,
      caption = "GLMER Result: Significant Masking (p = .012*)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size=12)
    )
}
```

### 2. Transcription data analysis

```{r transcription-data-cleaning-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#### helper functions & batch processing ####

# clean special characters
mgsub <- function(pattern, replacement, x, ...) {
  result <- x
  for (i in 1:length(pattern)) {
    result <- gsub(pattern[i], replacement[i], result, ...)
  }
  result
}

# scoring keywords
num.keywords.correct <- function(transcription, keywords) {
  keys <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  return(sum(!is.na(pmatch(unlist(strsplit(keys, " ")), unlist(strsplit(trans, " "))))))
}

# check individual keywords
check_keywords_correct <- function(transcription, keywords, global_row_id, filename, participant_id) {
  keys <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  keys.list <- unlist(strsplit(keys, " "))
  trans.list <- unlist(strsplit(trans, " "))
  
  correct_matches <- keys.list %in% trans.list
  
  return(data.frame(
    global_row_id = global_row_id, 
    participant_id = participant_id,
    Filename = filename,
    keyword = keys.list,
    is_correct = correct_matches
  ))
}

# clean questionnaire data
clean_questionnaire_robust <- function(file_path) {
  d <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) 
  if(!all(c("stimuli_presented", "response_value") %in% names(d))) return(NULL)
  
  d %>%
    filter(stimuli_presented %in% c("exposure_spanish_accent", "exposure_spanish")) %>%
    select(participant_id, question_id = stimuli_presented, answer = response_value) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = question_id, values_from = answer) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
}

# batch processing function

process_transcription_batch <- function(folder_name, group_label, batch_label, has_questionnaire) {
  
  message(paste("Processing Batch:", batch_label, "..."))
  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)
  
  trans_files <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "transcription_data.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if(length(trans_files) == 0) { warning(paste("  ! No data found for", batch_label)); return(NULL) }
  
  d_combined <- map_dfr(trans_files, function(f_path) {
    temp_d <- read_csv(f_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
    fname <- basename(f_path)
    temp_d$run_type <- ifelse(str_starts(fname, "test_run"), "Test Run", "Official")
    return(temp_d)
  })
  
  key_file <- "../data/transcription_scoring.txt"
  if(!file.exists(key_file)) { warning("Key file missing"); return(NULL) }
  key.df <- read.delim(key_file, header = TRUE, sep = ",")
  key.df$Sentence <- as.character(key.df$Sentence)
  
  d.trans <- d_combined %>%
    filter(!is.na(stimulus_files_presented) & stimulus_files_presented != "" & block == "Transcription")
  d.trans$Filename <- basename(as.character(d.trans$stimulus_files_presented))
  d.trans$Transcription <- d.trans$response_value
  
  d.all.m <- merge(d.trans, subset(key.df, select = -c(SentenceSet)),
                   by.x = "Filename", by.y = "Sentence", sort = FALSE)
  
  if(nrow(d.all.m) == 0) { warning(paste("  ! Merge failed for", batch_label)); return(NULL) }
  
  d.all.m <- within(d.all.m, {
    Transcription <- tolower(mgsub(c("&lt&", "&gt&", "&quot&", "&comma&", "&semicol&", "&pipe&", "&apos&"), 
                                   c("<", ">", '"', ",", ";", "|", "'"), Transcription))
    NumKeywordsCorrect <- mapply(num.keywords.correct, Transcription, Keywords)
    PropKeywordsCorrect <- NumKeywordsCorrect / as.numeric(NumKeywords)
  })
  
  d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- NA_character_
  if(has_questionnaire) {
    q_files <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
    if(length(q_files) > 0) {
      df_quest_all <- map_dfr(q_files, clean_questionnaire_robust) %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
      d.all.m <- left_join(d.all.m, df_quest_all, by = "participant_id")
      if("quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y" %in% names(d.all.m)) {
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.x <- NULL; d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y <- NULL
      }
    }
  }
  
  d.all.m$batch_id <- batch_label
  d.all.m$group <- group_label
  return(d.all.m)
}

# filtering participants

run_lean_plots <- function(df_input) {

  # main adaptation effect: Did the Experimental group perform better overall?
  
  summ_group <- df_input %>% 
    group_by(batch_id) %>% 
    summarise(
      stats = list(smean.cl.boot(PropKeywordsCorrect)), 
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>% 
    tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)
  
  p_comparison <- ggplot(summ_group, aes(x = batch_id, y = Mean, color = batch_id)) +
    geom_jitter(data = df_input %>% group_by(batch_id, participant_id) %>% summarise(M=mean(PropKeywordsCorrect, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop"), 
                aes(y = M), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 1.5, color = "gray50") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.15, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 5, shape = 19) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Mean, accuracy = 0.1)), 
              hjust = -0.4, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(
      title = "Accent Adaptation Effect (Group Comparison)", 
      subtitle = "Dot = Mean | Error Bar = 95% Confidence Interval",
      y = "Mean Accuracy",
      x = NULL
    ) + 
  theme(legend.position="none")
  
  # hardest keywords
  df_input <- df_input %>% mutate(global_row_id = row_number())
  
  kw_df <- pmap_dfr(list(df_input$Transcription, 
                         df_input$Keywords, 
                         df_input$global_row_id, 
                         df_input$Filename, 
                         df_input$participant_id), 
                    check_keywords_correct)
  
  kw_df <- kw_df %>% 
    left_join(df_input %>% select(global_row_id, batch_id), by="global_row_id")
  

  hardest <- kw_df %>% 
    group_by(keyword, batch_id) %>% 
    summarise(P = mean(is_correct, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>% 
    group_by(batch_id) %>% 
    arrange(P) %>% 
    slice_head(n=10)
  
  
  p_error <- ggplot(hardest, aes(x = reorder_within(keyword, P, batch_id), 
                                 y = P, 
                                 fill = batch_id)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
    # Use scale_x_reordered to clean up the labels
    scale_x_reordered() +
    facet_wrap(~batch_id, scales = "free") + 
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    labs(title = "Hardest Keywords", x = NULL, y = "Proportion Correct") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # print(p_learning)
  print(p_comparison)
  print(p_error)

}

##### hardest keywords table #####
get_hardest_keywords_table <- function(df_input, top_n = 15) {
  
  
  df_input <- df_input %>% mutate(global_row_id = row_number())
  
  kw_df <- pmap_dfr(
    list(df_input$Transcription, df_input$Keywords, df_input$global_row_id, df_input$Filename, df_input$participant_id),
    check_keywords_correct 
  )
  
  kw_df <- kw_df %>% 
    left_join(df_input %>% select(global_row_id, batch_id), by="global_row_id")
  
  hardest_table <- kw_df %>% 
    group_by(batch_id, keyword) %>% 
    summarise(
      Total_Attempts = n(),
      Count_Correct = sum(is_correct, na.rm=TRUE),
      Prop_Correct_Raw = mean(is_correct, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>% 
    arrange(batch_id, Prop_Correct_Raw) %>% 
    
    group_by(batch_id) %>% 
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>% 
    mutate(
      Accuracy = scales::percent(Prop_Correct_Raw, accuracy = 0.1)
    ) %>% 
    select(Batch = batch_id, Keyword = keyword, Accuracy, Correct = Count_Correct, Total = Total_Attempts)
  
  return(hardest_table)
}


hardest_keywords <- get_hardest_keywords_table(df_transcription_all, top_n = 15)
```

```{r accent-adaptation-group-comparison-stats, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

run_adaptation_stats <- function(df_input) {
  
# baseline group is the reference level
  df_stats <- df_input %>%
    mutate(
      batch_id = factor(batch_id, levels = c("Baseline", "Main Batch 3")),
      participant_id = factor(participant_id),
      Filename = factor(Filename)
    )
  

  message("\n---Analysis 1: Participant-Level t-test ---")
  
  df_agg <- df_stats %>%
    group_by(participant_id, batch_id) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  t_res <- t_test(df_agg, Mean_Accuracy ~ batch_id, var.equal = FALSE)
  
  eff_size <- df_agg %>% cohens_d(Mean_Accuracy ~ batch_id, var.equal = FALSE)
  
  print(t_res)
  message(paste("Effect Size (Cohen's d):", round(eff_size$effsize, 3)))
  

  message("\n--- Analysis 2: Linear Mixed Effects Model ---")
  message("Formula: Accuracy ~ Group + (1|Participant) + (1|Sentence)")
  
  lmm_model <- lmer(PropKeywordsCorrect ~ batch_id + (1|participant_id) + (1|Filename), 
                    data = df_stats)
  
  print(summary(lmm_model))
  


  coefs <- fixef(lmm_model)
  intercept <- coefs["(Intercept)"] 
  slope <- coefs["batch_idMain Batch 3"] 
  
  message("\n--- Results ---")
  message(paste0("Baseline Mean Accuracy: ", scales::percent(intercept, 0.1)))
  message(paste0("Adaptation Effect:      ", ifelse(slope > 0, "+", ""), scales::percent(slope, 0.1)))
  
  p_val <- summary(lmm_model)$coefficients["batch_idMain Batch 3", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  if(p_val < 0.05) {
    message("RESULT: SIGNIFICANT. The main group performed significantly better.")
  } else {
    message("RESULT: NOT SIGNIFICANT. No statistical difference found between groups.")
  }
}

run_adaptation_stats(df_transcription_all)
```
